# Naive reference implementation following the prose contract directly.
import random, json
from bisect import bisect_right

def range_of(borders, rank):
    return bisect_right(borders, rank) - 1

def controller(borders, W, H, R, Q, L):
    W2 = [W[i]//2 + H[i] for i in range(R)]
    S = sum(W2)
    trig = (S>0 and R>1 and (2*R*min(W2) < S or R*max(W2) > 2*S))
    if not trig:
        return borders, W2
    mn = min(W2)
    a = W2.index(mn)
    if a==0: b=1
    elif a==R-1: b=R-2
    else:
        if W2[a-1] <= W2[a+1]: b=a-1
        else: b=a+1
    lo=min(a,b); hi=max(a,b)
    nb = borders[:lo+1] + borders[hi+1:]
    nw = W2[:lo] + [W2[lo]+W2[hi]] + W2[hi+1:]
    el = [i for i in range(len(nw)) if nb[i+1]-nb[i] >= 2]
    if not el:
        return borders, W2
    best = el[0]; bw = nw[best]
    for i in el[1:]:
        if nw[i] > bw:
            best=i; bw=nw[i]
    mid = (nb[best]+nb[best+1])//2
    w = nw[best]
    fb = nb[:best+1] + [mid] + nb[best+1:]
    fw = nw[:best] + [w//2, w-w//2] + nw[best+1:]
    return fb, fw

def stream_ref(obj):
    Q=obj['banks']; L=obj['lanes']; U=obj['limit']; borders=obj['borders']
    R=len(borders)-1; C=obj['capacity']; E=obj['epoch']; steps=obj['steps']
    banks=[[] for _ in range(Q)]  # list of [rank,ordinal,id,adt]
    rr=[[(r+l)%Q for l in range(L)] for r in range(R)]
    W=[0]*R; H=[0]*R
    nb=0; ordn=0
    att=acc=drop=dep=idle=0
    inv=tie=comp=ws=wm=0
    events=[]
    for k,st in enumerate(steps):
        t=st['t']; serve=st['serve']; arr=st['arrivals']
        upd=None
        if E>0 and k>0 and k%E==0:
            borders,W=controller(borders,W,H,R,Q,L)
            H=[0]*R
            rr=[[(r+l)%Q for l in range(L)] for r in range(R)]
            upd={"borders":list(borders),"weights":list(W)}
        svc=None
        if serve:
            q=nb; nb=(nb+1)%Q
            if banks[q]:
                # find min (rank,ordinal)
                mi=0
                for i in range(1,len(banks[q])):
                    a=banks[q][i]; bb=banks[q][mi]
                    if (a[0],a[1])<(bb[0],bb[1]): mi=i
                p=banks[q][mi]
                # stats over all residents incl p
                x=y=z=0
                tot=0
                for bi in range(Q):
                    for r2 in banks[bi]:
                        tot+=1
                same=0
                for bi in range(Q):
                    for r2 in banks[bi]:
                        if r2[0]<p[0]: x+=1
                        if r2[0]==p[0]:
                            same+=1
                            if r2[1]<p[1]: y+=1
                z=tot-same
                del banks[q][mi]
                wait=t-p[3]
                svc={"bank":q,"packet":{"id":p[2],"rank_error":x,"tie_overtakes":y,"comparable":z,"wait":wait}}
                dep+=1; inv+=x; tie+=y; comp+=z; ws+=wait
                if wait>wm: wm=wait
            else:
                idle+=1; svc={"bank":q,"packet":None}
        out=[]
        for pkt in sorted(arr,key=lambda p:p['lane']):
            rank=pkt['rank']; r=range_of(borders,rank); H[r]+=1
            ln=pkt['lane']; q=rr[r][ln]; rr[r][ln]=(q+1)%Q
            if len(banks[q])<C:
                banks[q].append([rank,ordn,pkt['id'],t]); acc+=1; ok=True
            else:
                drop+=1; ok=False
            att+=1
            out.append({"id":pkt['id'],"range":r,"bank":q,"accepted":ok})
            ordn+=1
        sizes=[len(b) for b in banks]
        events.append({"t":t,"update":upd,"service":svc,"arrivals":out,"sizes":sizes})
    queues=[[p[2] for p in sorted(banks[q],key=lambda e:(e[0],e[1]))] for q in range(Q)]
    final={"borders":list(borders),"weights":list(W),"histogram":list(H),
           "rr":[list(x) for x in rr],"next_bank":nb,"queues":queues,
           "totals":{"attempted":att,"accepted":acc,"dropped":drop,"departed":dep,
                     "idle":idle,"inversions":inv,"tie_overtakes":tie,
                     "comparable":comp,"wait_sum":ws,"wait_max":wm}}
    return {"events":events,"final":final}

def burst_ref(obj):
    Q=obj['banks']; L=obj['lanes']; U=obj['limit']; borders=obj['borders']
    R=len(borders)-1; sb=obj['start_bank']; pkts=obj['packets']
    N=len(pkts)
    rr=[[(r+l)%Q for l in range(L)] for r in range(R)]
    n=[[0]*Q for _ in range(R)]
    banks=[[] for _ in range(Q)]
    assignment=[]; rank_info=[]
    for ordi,pkt in enumerate(pkts):
        rank=pkt['rank']; lane=pkt['lane']
        r=range_of(borders,rank); q=rr[r][lane]; rr[r][lane]=(q+1)%Q
        n[r][q]+=1
        banks[q].append([rank,ordi,pkt['id']])
        rank_info.append(r)
        assignment.append({"id":pkt['id'],"range":r,"bank":q})
    observed=[0]*R
    deps=[]; tick=0; dep=0; idle=0
    while dep<N:
        q=(sb+tick)%Q
        if banks[q]:
            mi=0
            for i in range(1,len(banks[q])):
                a=banks[q][i]; bb=banks[q][mi]
                if (a[0],a[1])<(bb[0],bb[1]): mi=i
            p=banks[q][mi]
            x=y=z=0; tot=0; same=0
            for bi in range(Q):
                for r2 in banks[bi]:
                    tot+=1
                    if r2[0]<p[0]: x+=1
                    if r2[0]==p[0]:
                        same+=1
                        if r2[1]<p[1]: y+=1
            z=tot-same
            del banks[q][mi]
            r=rank_info[p[1]]
            if x>observed[r]: observed[r]=x
            deps.append({"t":tick,"bank":q,"id":p[2],"rank_error":x,"tie_overtakes":y,"comparable":z})
            dep+=1
        else:
            idle+=1
        tick+=1
    ranges=[]
    pref=0
    for r in range(R):
        tot=sum(n[r]); pref+=tot
        if tot==0: B=0
        else:
            first=pref-1; mx=max(n[r]); second=(Q-1)*(r*L+mx); B=min(first,second)
        ranges.append({"counts":list(n[r]),"bound":B,"observed":observed[r]})
    return {"assignment":assignment,"departures":deps,"ranges":ranges,"ticks":tick,"idle":idle}
PYEOF
